recital_filter.rule: drop if >=2 marker groups, or 1 group with no substance token, or name-density >= 0.28 with no substance token

boilerplate_filter.rule: drop if stock-phrase coverage >= 0.50; or >=3 trial-history phrases with coverage >= 0.25; or cross-judgment 6-gram Jaccard >= 0.35 with coverage >= 0.30; or coverage >= 0.30 with no substance token
boilerplate_filter.stock_phrase_bank: 6-grams occurring in >= 3 distinct judgments, mined from the pairs themselves

windowing_noise: pairs whose passage also cites another section; flagged in `competing_sections`, NOT dropped
grouped_by: connected components over shared gold chunks
intended_use: retriever training only — NOT an evaluation set; see module docstring for the OCR and register reasons
